name: VHS
description: Consumer VHS tape: 4:3, ~330 lines, chroma bleed, tape noise, head-switching bar.
rationale: VHS records luma at roughly 3 MHz (~330 lines of horizontal resolution) and chroma 'color-under' at ~0.6 MHz, so color smears sideways far more than brightness — modelled by the YCC-separated chroma blur+offset, not an RGB blur. Time-base error wobbles scanline start positions (horizontal displace by low-frequency noise). The head-switching point sits at the bottom of the frame. Composite levels ride on 16-235 setup, hence lifted blacks (16/255) and clipped whites (235/255). Playback sharpening circuits overshoot edges: unsharp halos.
